authority: ChatGPT curriculum design; Kevin acceptance required

policy.wordReadingMeaning: requiresReading refers to reading written words, not identifying musical notation; provide picture/gesture/caregiver alternatives
policy.selfCheckHuman: mic is single-pitch only; hands-together, pedaling, voicing, body technique and artistic assessments need human confirmation
policy.mastery: PROPOSED C6: Secure >=80% first-try on 2 different days where suitable; stage/rubric overrides and human confirmations required
policy.review: PROPOSED C6: 1,3,7,21,60-day spaced prompts; never punitive or lesson-blocking
policy.session: PROPOSED C7: 10-20 minutes, warm-up, targeted skill, piano application, reflection; no practice-day gate
policy.licensing: PROPOSED C8: original or public-domain in-app examples; learner-supplied sheet music only in user-managed practice
policy.levelStopCount: NQ-00 has 6, NQ-01..08 each 8; each unique world
